rollover_policy.trigger: Five reviewed CME trading sessions before the earliest of first_intent_date, first_notice_date, last_trade_date, and broker_closeout_date
rollover_policy.target: Next eligible listed maturity with verified provider security ID and overlapping raw price observations
rollover_policy.execution: Close old and open new at the scheduled session open; decisions fixed before that open
rollover_policy.costs: Two executions with their own commission, spread and slippage
rollover_policy.missing_calendar_or_contract_data: Reject experiment; do not infer NYSE sessions, notices, provider IDs, prices or volume
rollover_policy.continuous_usage: research/reference only; fills and PnL require individual contract prices and contract IDs
rollover_policy.reason_for_v2: CME delivery advisories distinguish first intent/position from first notice; the earlier delivery exposure must be considered

implementation_status: Three public provider identities and overlapping observed histories archived with checksums; CME expiry dates manually observed. Specific intent/notice dates, session calendar, broker cutoff, provider bar/settlement semantics and validated execution chain remain unresolved
